guidance.startEngine: Core function: Starts the vehicle's engine. Success patterns: Engine starts successfully when all doors are locked and the brake pedal is fully pressed. Common issues: Engine fails to start if doors are unlocked or brake pedal is not pressed. Best practices: Ensure all doors are securely locked and press the brake pedal fully before initiating the engine.
